title: Impeller Recommender for Real Airstreams
description: Ten shuffled job cards describing real airstreams, each placed in one of seven impeller bins (HAF, HIB, RTF, RBA, RBO, RBW, RBP). Two attempts per card: a wrong first try asks what the material does, a wrong second try shows the best fit and the catalog reason. Mastery is 8 of 10 correct on the first try; the summary lists each card's first choice and best fit.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Matching centrifugal impeller types to clean and dirty airstreams
learningObjectives: The learner will recommend one of seven impeller types for each of ten airstream descriptions, judged against Twin City Fan's catalog application statements, with at least 8 of 10 correct.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); bin buttons carry aria-labels with the full name and description; verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed card borders pair with colour; keys 1-7 place, Enter next, D toggles the bin descriptions; focus moves to Next card after a final verdict.

rules: One bin per card; a card is correct only in the bin from the spec's 'Correct impeller' column.
Cards 1 and 2, 4 and 5, and 9 and 10 share a bin; the learner is not told how many cards belong in each bin.
Two attempts per card; only the first try counts toward the score and mastery (8 of 10).
assumptions: Job settings such as 'process tank' and 'stamping line' are illustrative wrappers around the catalog statements.
limitations: Real selections come from the catalog performance tables and the application engineer; this sorter covers impeller type only.

sources: Source: tcf.com product pages (Radial Bladed Fans: RBA, RBO, RBW, RBP; Radial Tip & High Efficiency Fans: RTF, HAF, HIB), retrieved 2026-10-08

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit a recommendation for each realistic job, then see the catalog reasoning; the retry prompt builds the 'what does the material do' habit.
keyQuestions: Does the material stick, wrap, strike or pass through?
Is the efficiency of a clean-air wheel worth the risk on this airstream?
commonMisconceptions: The most efficient impeller is always the best choice.
Any radial bladed impeller handles any dirty airstream.
Paper shreddings and corrugated trim need the same impeller.
Radial tip fans are only for clean air.
assessmentOpportunities: First-try score shown as 'Recommendations correct on first try: n of 10'; mastery is 8 of 10 on the first try.
